title: A Fantastic Evening with Maria in Barcelona!
text:
What a wonderful experience! This truly was a small-group VIP tour, as it was just my wife, our guide Maria, and me! It felt like having our own private tour of Barcelona’s beautiful Gothic Quarter.

Maria was absolutely fantastic! We visited three charming restaurants tucked away in the narrow streets of the Gothic Quarter, enjoying delicious, authentic Catalan food and wine. There was plenty of food, so definitely come hungry!
